name: Intersection of Sovereign St. & Oak St.
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. The intersection is clean and well-kept, and
desc3: banners hung from the posts flutter gaily in the breeze. Buildings
desc4: tower over you in the corners of the crossing streets. Sovereign
desc5: street continues to the north and south, and Oak street to the east
